definitions.unique_descendants: U_beta(v)=sum_{u: d(u,v)>=1} beta^(d(u,v)-1); each reachable citing paper counted once at shortest distance.
definitions.branching_descendants: B_beta(v)=U_beta(v)*(1-sum_b p_b^2), p_b=M_b/U; allocate each unique descendant vote equally over first-generation branches lying on shortest paths.
definitions.katz_paths: K_beta(v)=sum_{paths ending at v, length>=1} beta^(length-1); finite on chronological DAG. Standard comparator, not claimed original.

limitations: Citation paths do not establish idea inheritance.
B deliberately discounts one concentrated lineage, including important breakthroughs spread through one successor.
Missing links and corpus selection affect all reachability measures.
Paper branches are not independently verified research teams.
No AI-authorship inference or stylistic penalty is used.

semantic_metrics.score: R(v)=sum_u max_reviewed_context_weight(u,v); extension=2, method=1, component=0.5; each citing paper counted once.
limits: Only heuristic-positive contexts were reviewed; recall and a held-out classifier quality are not estimated.
The assistant made the context judgments; they are not independent human validation.
Unreviewed or missing contexts are unknown, not confirmed non-use.
Ranks compare observed evidence under unequal coverage, not complete true semantic influence.
Weights are explicit modeling choices, not empirically calibrated values.

experiments.tie_policy: Values rounded to 12 decimals; midranks; remaining top-5 slots divided equally across boundary ties.
experiments.graph_policy: All 140 nodes retained. B uses chronological edges as before; local, PR and F use all remaining edges.
experiments.fractional_definition: F(v)=sum_(u->v) 1/outdegree_G(u), using observed in-corpus references, recomputed after deletion.
experiments.interpretation: Sensitivity frequencies and 5-95 percentile ranges under specified deletion models, NOT confidence intervals or truth probabilities.
limitations: Deletion cannot measure bias from papers absent from the corpus or undetected missing links.
Shared author IDs are imperfect metadata proxies; non-overlap does not prove independent teams.
Fractional weighting uses corpus references, not full bibliographies, and can amplify incompletely observed sources.
No ranking proves method reuse or scientific breakthrough.

method_sources.use: Fractional counting precedent; our denominator is corpus-local, not the full bibliography.
Author IDs and potential byline truncation.

limitations: Exact-title matching can miss changed titles and PDF extraction errors.
Bibliography title matching is not exhaustive human review of every source.
Numerical checks do not validate the scientific interpretation of a ranking.

metrics_verification.note: Numerical/provenance checks; no independent validation of semantic annotation or scientific novelty.

checks: independent dense PageRank, local and fractional ranks
all reported frequencies and rank intervals match saved simulations
